purpose: Compare Traditional, New-PR, New-SW, and New-CPA at conventional and supercritical-water conditions on the same 60x20x1 grid.

model_description.governing_equations: Fully implicit component mass conservation with Darcy phase fluxes and closed external boundaries; wells are the only external sources and sinks.

thermodynamics.Traditional: PR hydrocarbon gas with independent pure-water phase; no aqueous CO2 dissolution.
thermodynamics.New-PR: Fully compositional H2O-CO2 flash with Peng-Robinson fugacity model.
thermodynamics.New-SW: Fully compositional H2O-CO2 flash with Spycher-Wagner correlations.
thermodynamics.New-CPA: Fully compositional H2O-CO2 flash with opt-in CPA association model.

model_description.aqueous_properties: Locked IAPWS+Garcia density and McBride-Wright viscosity closures.

units: SI internally; temperature K, pressure Pa, length m, time s, mass kg. Reports use MPa and days where labeled.

acceptance_criteria.completion: All eight runs reach 365.25 days with no failed step.
acceptance_criteria.inactive_nC10: Report absolute numerical trace separately; do not treat the relative error of a nominal-zero component as an active-component failure.
acceptance_criteria.plot_integrity: Common color limits within every four-model panel; no interpolation; phase composition masked where the phase is absent.
